title: Logo, seal and signatures on documents
body: Set the logo and company seal, name the signatories and choose who signs each kind of document and whether the seal is stamped. Issued documents never change: each keeps what was in force on its issue date.
partnerBody: The logo, seal and authorised signatories on the factory's documents (tax invoices, receipts and ERP documents), and your own signature
readOnly: You can view only; changing these needs the document settings permission

marks.title: Logo and seal
marks.body: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. It is resized for print, and a seal's white paper is made transparent.
marks.logoHint: At the top of every document
marks.sealHint: Stamped on the kinds of document chosen below. A photo of the seal stamped on white paper is fine.
marks.removed: {kind} removed — documents issued from now on carry no {kind}

signatories.title: Signatories
signatories.body: Name who may sign documents. Each signatory uploads their own signature on the “My signature” page — an administrator cannot upload it for them.
signatories.removeBody: {name}'s signature will not appear on documents issued from now on. Documents already issued keep it.

rules.title: Who signs what
rules.body: Choose the signatory and the seal for each kind of document. Applies to documents issued from now on.
rules.noSignatory: — No signature (a blank line to sign by hand) —

preview.title: Preview a document
preview.body: A sample document (marked “sample”) with the settings as they are now

mine.title: My signature
mine.body: Printed on the documents you are assigned to sign, from the moment you save. Only you can set or withdraw your signature.
mine.none: You are not a signatory. The document settings administrator names signatories.
mine.signsNone: No kind of document is assigned to you yet
mine.imageHint: Sign on white paper and take a photo; the white is made transparent
mine.withdrawBody: Documents issued from now on will have a blank line to sign by hand.

pad.label: Signature
pad.hint: Drag a finger or the mouse to sign
